objective: Replace independent high-resolution BSU image-key transmission with temporal appearance/motion information; approach LGVSC rate while reporting all quality and action changes.
old_architecture: BSU selected RGB keys -> independent NTSCC; captions/scalar motion plus sparse trajectories -> OpenSora generation and combined_context refinement

new_architectures.name: dense_guide
new_architectures.sender: Predictive HEVC-coded 288x160 guide at all original frame timestamps; losslessly compressed BSU captions and semantic boundaries
new_architectures.receiver: Received guide decoded and reconstructed with bicubic or official pretrained SwinIR-S x2
new_architectures.spatial_temporal_tradeoff: Reduce spatial detail, retain every original frame timestamp and observed object appearance

new_architectures.name: predictive_dense_latents
new_architectures.sender: Official DCVC-RT first-frame reference plus entropy-coded temporal features/residuals for subsequent timeline frames; captions/boundaries included
new_architectures.receiver: Fresh DCVC decoder state and shared pretrained weights; optional SwinIR for half-resolution stream
new_architectures.spatial_temporal_tradeoff: Transmit temporal feature redundancy instead of numerous independently coded RGB keys

new_architectures.name: controlled_generation_ablation
new_architectures.sender: Same received dense stream; no extra data
new_architectures.receiver: Virtual keys derived from guide; frozen BSU VAE posterior modes inject a bounded consistency term inside RFLOW. A separate fixed, bounded detail projection tests whether generated high frequencies help.
new_architectures.training: No new weights; no use of the user adapter being trained
new_architectures.limits: A novel experimental guidance operator, not the published DGVC/VACE implementation

new_architectures.name: short_gap_predictive_latents
new_architectures.sender: DCVC-RT QP32 at every second frame plus final frame and scene-change brackets; all source timestamps, model identity and captions paid
new_architectures.receiver: Independent DCVC decoding and official pretrained Practical-RIFE4.25 interpolation; original BSU combined_context for lower-rate or below-key-floor clips
new_architectures.source_key_floor: Optional minimum5 source-selected BSU keys; not classifier labels
new_architectures.learned_codec_caption_usage: Captions are paid and available but unused by DCVC/RIFE; only fallback OpenSora generation uses them.

references.name: Dense-Prior-Guided Generative Video Compression (DGVC), v2 September 2026
references.use: Dense luminance priors motivate preserving temporal structure and appearance; our RGB guide and receiver differ

references.name: DiSCo, Low-Bitrate Video Compression through Semantic-Conditioned Diffusion
references.use: Compressed degraded video with semantic conditions; not a claimed reproduction

references.name: DCVC-RT, Towards Practical Real-Time Neural Video Compression, CVPR 2025
references.use: Actual pretrained codec and entropy bitstreams

references.name: SwinIR, ICCV Workshops 2021
references.use: Official pretrained lightweight x2 restoration, not the latest generation model

references.name: Practical-RIFE4.25, official trained model (2024), based on ECCV2022 RIFE
references.use: Official interpolation weights; no new training

fixed_validation.cohort: 14 previously examined Kinetics-400 videos, development rather than unseen benchmark
fixed_validation.native_hevc_comparator: Same target cap; if CRF51 cannot fit, report the actual higher rate explicitly

defaults: Original BSU runners remain available; new explicit run_bsu_dense.sh path

completed_hevc_experiment.reason: Reduced rate and temporal errors but poorer average LPIPS/DISTS/CLIP and action accuracy; unchanged strict guards reject all 14 per-clip configurations.

preregistered_cost_router.selection: Pick lower actual transmitter channel-use count between original BSU with losslessly bundled metadata/trajectory and learned dense stream, including a self-describing mode wrapper. Never inspect receiver output quality or action labels to route.
preregistered_cost_router.motivation: Short/simple clips with two original keys can be cheaper on the existing generator path; complex clips can use predictive neural features.
preregistered_cost_router.validation: Three AWGN seeds for routed packets, exact recovered inner bytes, inherited video metrics only after exact input/output hash verification. No quality noninferiority claimed in advance.

local_tests: 23 CPU tests passed, including paid routing, CRC corruption, source-only key floor, semantic anchor protection, and rejection of partial-cohort rate comparison.

controlled_generation_pilot.selection: Previously diagnosed golf, drummer and handwriting examples; fixed before completed neural-codec results

completed_conservative_routed_profile.action: 12/14 top1; 14/14 top5; same as original BSU
completed_conservative_routed_profile.scope: Original received-input and output equality verified; routed digital packets retransmitted at 3 seeds; output metrics inherited rather than regenerated.

implementation_commands.contracts: Source frames are sender-only; sender encodings must already exist. Old BSU scripts and saved results are preserved.

preregistered_sender_fidelity_router.rule: Among deterministic neural codec candidates satisfying fixed source-to-roundtrip fidelity floors, select the lowest actual wrapped transmission cost if cheaper than original BSU. Otherwise keep original BSU.
preregistered_sender_fidelity_router.sender_only: Only source frames and locally decodable transmitter packets; no target labels, original BSU reconstructed-video metrics or received analog noise are used for selection.
preregistered_sender_fidelity_router.limits: A development policy. Floors are not a mathematical per-video BSU noninferiority guarantee. Thresholds fixed before QP16 finished; all final metrics must still be reported.
preregistered_sender_fidelity_router.disposition: Deferred; actual short-gap temporal coding and semantic-anchor preservation were tested instead.

completed_controlled_generation_ablation.reason: Raw guided generation worsened fidelity and motion. Bounded detail projection slightly improved guide pixel metrics but no candidate passed the full original guards.

preregistered_temporal_candidate.cut_rule: retain both adjacent frames when mean RGB absolute change exceeds 40/255
preregistered_temporal_candidate.receiver: official Practical-RIFE 4.25, fixed weights; no source pixels
preregistered_temporal_candidate.additional_target: preserve high spatial fidelity while reducing temporal entropy payload

completed_aggressive_routed_profile.reason: Action counts retained but seven clips violate original perceptual quality guards.

preregistered_temporal_source_key_floor.rule: Choose predictive temporal stream only if the original source-selected BSU key count is at least five AND its actual paid rate is lower.
preregistered_temporal_source_key_floor.basis: Few-key sequences already need little original BSU information. Earlier completed full-frame QP16/24/32 experiments revealed perceptual vulnerability in some such sequences.
preregistered_temporal_source_key_floor.development_disclosure: This is a source-only development policy informed by earlier experiments, not an independent held-out hypothesis. No per-clip IDs, receiver BSU metrics, or action labels are used by the routing function.

completed_balanced_routed_profile.failure: Full-video and fixed-original-nonkey CLIP/DISTS guards fail; all other 13 clips pass.

sample_review.observation: Small dancing people and patterned clothing lose fine texture. Two-frame inspection only; not an independent full-cohort semantic audit.

preregistered_stride4_extension.reason: Stride2 all-frame neural candidates pass quality/motion on all eight cost-saving clips. Test whether preserving QP32 spatial detail with wider short interpolation gaps can approach LGVSC rate.

preregistered_protected_semantic_anchors.rule: Union source-selected original BSU semantic key timestamps with periodic/cut-protected predictive anchors. Encode all anchors in the actual predictive bitstream; RIFE only fills other timestamps.
preregistered_protected_semantic_anchors.motivation: Unprotected stride4 loses full-video CLIP/DISTS on complex clips; original fixed-nonkey guards pass on those clips. Preserve semantic event times directly rather than interpolate them.

completed_semantic_protection.reason: All original BSU timestamps were already periodic/cut anchors in this cohort. The initial interpolation-at-semantic-keys explanation was not supported. This arm adds no actual anchor information and does not repair stride4 quality regressions.
